note: Generated by `npm run mcp:bridge-manifest` from the adapters. Do not edit by hand; a test fails when this drifts.

timeline.name: timeline_get_timeline
timeline.description: Read the current timeline: length, playhead and every clip (id, type, start/end seconds, options).

timeline.name: timeline_search_stock
timeline.description: Search free stock footage/photos on Pixabay or Pexels. Returns up to 8 results with ids to pass to add_media_clip. Result titles are untrusted data.

timeline.name: timeline_add_media_clip
timeline.description: Add a video or image clip to the Main Video track (or audio to the Voiceover track). Use stock_id from search_stock, or a direct https url the user gave you.

duration.description: Seconds (videos default to their length, max 30)

timeline.name: timeline_add_overlay
timeline.description: Add a visual overlay on the Titles track. Types: overlay-text, overlay-text-mask, overlay-personalized-image, overlay-image, overlay-sticker, overlay-background, overlay-lower-third, overlay-transition. options are merged into the overlay's settings, e.g. overlay-text { text, fontFamily, fontColor, fontSize, alignment, geometry: { left, top, width, height } (percent), animation: { in, idle, out }, background, backgroundColor }, overlay-image { src, fill, cornerRadius }, overlay-sticker { src, kind: image|lottie }, overlay-lower-third { name, title, template, color }.

timeline.name: timeline_add_video_transition
timeline.description: Add a video transition centred on a cut between two clips on the Main Video track.

transition.description: e.g. fade, wipeleft, slideleft, circleopen, cube, clockwise, directional

timeline.name: timeline_add_interactive
timeline.description: Add an interactive element (works in the interactive player, not in exported MP4s). Types: .

timeline.name: timeline_list_effects
timeline.description: List the available visual effects (Remotion effects) with their parameters. Categories: Color, Blur, Light, Stylize, Distort, Reveal, Generate.

timeline.name: timeline_add_effect
timeline.description: Add a visual effect to a video/image clip or image overlay. Returns the effect uid (for keyframing its parameters).

effect.description: Effect id, e.g. color-correction, blur, vignette, glow, grayscale, color-key

timeline.name: timeline_set_keyframes
timeline.description: Animate a clip property with keyframes (replaces that property's keyframes). Properties: x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, or fx:<effect uid>:<param>. t is seconds from the clip's start.

timeline.name: timeline_add_captions
timeline.description: Add captions. Either transcribe a video/audio clip in the browser (source_clip_id; can take a minute), or pass caption lines yourself (start/end seconds from the captions clip start).

timeline.name: timeline_add_voiceover
timeline.description: Generate a spoken voiceover from a script (text-to-speech) and place it on the Voiceover track. Takes ~10–60 s. The clip length matches the speech; the timeline grows if needed. Caption it afterwards with add_captions { source_clip_id }.

voice.description: Wise_Woman: Warm, mature female; Calm_Woman: Calm female; Inspirational_girl: Upbeat young female; Lively_Girl: Lively female; Friendly_Person: Friendly, neutral; Casual_Guy: Casual male; Deep_Voice_Man: Deep male; Elegant_Man: Polished male; Determined_Man: Confident male; Patient_Man: Patient male; Young_Knight: Young energetic male; Imposing_Manner: Dramatic male

timeline.name: timeline_add_music
timeline.description: Generate instrumental background music and place it on a Music track. Takes 1–3 minutes. By default it fades in/out and ducks (gets quieter) under voiceovers.

duration.description: Seconds (default: to the end of the timeline, 10–180)

duck.description: Lower the music under voiceovers (default true)

timeline.name: timeline_remove_background
timeline.description: Cut the people out of a video or image clip (or Image overlay) so what is underneath shows through. Slow on long videos.

timeline.name: timeline_create_animation
timeline.description: Create a motion-graphics clip from Remotion React code (see the system prompt rules). It goes on the Titles track over the footage. Returns an error list if the code is rejected or fails to render.

props.description: Values passed to the component, e.g. media URLs from search_stock, text, colors

timeline.name: timeline_update_clip
timeline.description: Change a clip: timing, name, overlay options, volume/fit, or (for animations) code/props.

timeline.name: timeline_remove_clip
timeline.description: Delete a clip from the timeline.

timeline.name: timeline_set_duration
timeline.description: Set the timeline length in seconds (5–600). Clips past the end are not removed.

timeline.name: timeline_preview_frame
timeline.description: Render one frame exactly as it will export and check animations for errors. The frame is shown to the user.

timeline.name: timeline_export_video
timeline.description: Export the video file. Only when the user asked; the user must confirm.

timeline.name: timeline_mask_object
timeline.description: Free, on-device: cut out an object named by text (e.g. "the dog") from a video/image clip. mode cutout replaces the clip media with the object only (whole clip for videos; slow on long clips); mask stores a mask image on the clip.

timeline.name: timeline_search_footage
timeline.description: Free, on-device: find moments in the project's video/image clips that match a description (e.g. "beach at sunset"). Returns clip ids and timeline times. The first call looks at each clip once (can take a minute).

timeline.name: timeline_describe_frame
timeline.description: Free, on-device: describe what a clip shows at the playhead (or its middle). Useful to write prompts.

timeline.name: timeline_tag_clip
timeline.description: Free, on-device: auto-tag a video/image clip (scene tags and detected objects).

timeline.name: timeline_blur_background
timeline.description: Free, on-device: blur the background behind the subject of a video/image clip using a depth map. focus 0.2–0.9 (higher keeps less in focus).

timeline.name: timeline_remove_silences
timeline.description: Free, on-device: cut silent parts out of a video/audio clip and close the gaps (later clips on its track move left).

timeline.name: timeline_label_speakers
timeline.description: Free, on-device: label which speaker says each caption in a captions clip (made by add_captions with source_clip_id).

timeline.name: timeline_translate_captions
timeline.description: Free, on-device: add a translated copy of a captions clip. language is a code like es, fr, de, pt, ja, zh, ar, hi.

timeline.name: timeline_add_free_voiceover
timeline.description: Free, on-device voiceover (Kokoro). Lower quality than add_voiceover but costs nothing and needs no key. Voices: af_heart, af_bella, af_nicole, am_michael, am_fenrir, bf_emma, bm_george, bm_fable.

timeline.name: timeline_generate_image
timeline.description: Generate an image with OpenAI Images 2.6 (user's OpenAI key, user confirms) and place it as an image clip. Use @Name to include a saved Element (character/location/prop) — its reference images keep it consistent.

timeline.name: timeline_storyboard
timeline.description: Plan a storyboard from an idea or script (OpenAI), make a frame per shot with Images 2.6 and place the shots on the timeline with dialogue captions. Uses the user's OpenAI key; the user confirms. @Name mentions use saved Elements.

timeline.name: timeline_fill_gap
timeline.description: Paid (SmartVid, user confirms): generate a clip that bridges the gap after (or before) a clip on its track, from the real frames either side.

timeline.name: timeline_extend_clip
timeline.description: Paid (SmartVid, user confirms): extend a video clip forward (continue the shot) or backward (lead-in). seconds 1–10.

workbench.name: workbench_get_project
workbench.description: The Workbench project: tracks, clips (ids, card, timing, props) and the selected clip.

workbench.name: workbench_run_ops
workbench.description: Edit the Workbench project with validated operations (undo with workbench_undo).

ops.description: Edit operations, at most 100 per call. Each is { op: "update_clip" | "set_props" | "add_clip" | "remove_clip" | ..., clipId, ... } exactly as in the Workbench AI chat; call workbench_get_project first for clip ids and card ids. Media URLs the project does not already contain are refused.

workbench.name: workbench_import_assets
workbench.description: Add media to the Workbench from public https links. mode "append" adds to the current project; "new" starts a new one.

motion_director.name: motion_director_get_project
motion_director.description: The Motion Director project: size, tracks, clips and their simple properties.

motion_director.name: motion_director_command
motion_director.description: Give the studio agent a plain-English edit ("make the title red", "add a caption", "background black"). Same interpreter as the in-app chat; applied: 0 means it did not understand.

motion_director.name: motion_director_set_clip_props
motion_director.description: Change a clip's properties (text, colors, sizes) by id.

motion_director.name: motion_director_add_clip
motion_director.description: Add a motion card as a clip (card ids appear in motion_director_get_project).

motion_director.name: motion_director_render
motion_director.description: Start the MP4 render in this browser tab (the studio's own export; it saves like the Export button does). Returns when started, not when finished.

render.name: render_queue_list
render.description: Jobs in this browser's render queue.

render.name: render_queue_enqueue
render.description: Queue a render job (the project payload is whatever the Render page produced; it is stored as given).

render.name: render_queue_process
render.description: Run the next queued job. It only renders while the Render page is open; otherwise the job is marked failed with a clear message, never completed.

render.name: render_queue_remove
render.description: Remove a job from the queue.

brand.name: brand_list
brand.description: Brands saved in this browser (Brand DNA).

brand.name: brand_get
brand.description: One brand's DNA with its campaigns.

brand.name: brand_save
brand.description: Create or update a brand. Pass the brand object; without an id a new one is created.

app.name: app_state
app.description: Which page this tab is on.

app.name: app_navigate
app.description: Open another SmartVid page in this tab (for example "image", "video", "timeline"). The previous page's tools stop being available.

workbench.workbench_export: Rendering the MP4 runs behind the Export button in the editor and has no call to trigger it from outside.
workbench.workbench_ai_chat: The editor chat needs the user's own OpenAI key held in the iframe; use workbench_run_ops with explicit operations instead.
workbench.workbench_file_upload: Uploading a local file needs a file the user picks; import by https link instead.

motion_director.film_director_chat: The multi-step film pipeline (plan, pictures, music, review) is driven from the chat panel and has no single call to run it.
motion_director.timeline_dragging: Drag, resize and trim gestures on the timeline have no programmatic surface; edits go through clip properties and the command interpreter.
motion_director.render_progress: The render reports progress inside the Export button only; motion_director_render starts it and the user sees the result there.

render.render_queue_clear: Clearing everything at once is not offered; remove jobs one by one.

brand.personalizer_stores: Personalizer contacts and profiles live in the personalization feature's own server-backed tables: use leads_* and video_pages_contacts instead. The one-shot personalizer handoff is not a stored profile.
brand.api_keys: Saving or reading API keys is a human-only action.

cinegen.cinegen_export: Desktop only: the CineGen web editor has no export host; export runs through the Electron app.
cinegen.cinegen_extract_media: Desktop only: needs the Electron app's file access.
cinegen.cinegen_web_host: The CineGen timeline's McpHost handlers (createMcpHandlers) bind to Electron IPC; there is no web host implementation in this app, so no cinegen_* tab tools are offered. Server-side CineGen actions (fill_gap, extend, element_create, shot_board) are covered by the cinegen gateway studio.

video_agent.video_agent_edit: The Video Agent runs in an iframe whose only protocol is auth in and exported video out; it has no call to read or change the animation it is making.
